T: Site B was meant to stay off limits. So was the fridge.
D: Four years after the park disaster, Ian Malcolm is sent to a second island where the dinosaurs have been living wild.
P: Serve the snacks when the Bowman family's beach picnic gets a visit from something small and curious.
S: Beach picnic roast beef finger sandwiches
the Bowmans' yacht lunch on the sand, and the little ones want a bite

Beat 40g soft butter with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Spread over 8 slices white bread, layer 4 slices with 300g rare roast beef, 50g rocket and pepper and close. Trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.
packed for the hunt by Roland's oldest friend

Rub 3 tbsp oil into 200g plain flour and a pinch of salt, add 80ml water, knead and rest 30 minutes. Boil 500g diced potatoes until tender. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 diced onion in 2 tbsp oil, add 1 chopped green chilli, 1 tsp garam masala, half a tsp turmeric, the potato and 100g peas, then lemon and coriander, and cool. Roll the dough into 6 rounds, halve, shape into cones, fill and seal. Fry at 170C for 5 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g Greek yoghurt mixed with chopped mint.
M: grilled down by the InGen docks in San Diego

Blend the juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder, 3 tbsp oil and a handful of coriander and marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours. Char 4 tomatoes, half a white onion and 1 jalapeño in a dry pan and blitz with coriander, lime and salt. Grill the steak over high heat for 4 minutes a side, rest 10 minutes and slice across the grain. Serve with 12 warm corn tortillas, sliced avocado and the salsa.
W: the rex parents leave deep tracks in the mud, this goes deeper

Crush 250g chocolate biscuits, mix with 100g melted butter and press into a 23cm tin, then chill 20 minutes. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk 3 eggs with 150g brown sugar, then mix in the chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 150ml cream. Pour into the base and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cool, chill 2 hours and serve with 200ml whipped cream.
K: the rex stops for a drink in a San Diego swimming pool

Dissolve 40g caster sugar in 40ml hot water and cool. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt flakes. Shake 180ml tequila, 60ml blue curaçao, 120ml lime juice and the syrup hard with ice and strain into the glasses over fresh ice.

dishes.n: Beach picnic roast beef finger sandwiches
dishes.make_ahead: Make the horseradish butter up to 3 days ahead; build the sandwiches up to 2 hours ahead, covered with a damp tea towel in the fridge

steps.text: Beat the butter with the horseradish until smooth.
Spread over all 8 slices of bread. Layer 4 slices with the beef, rocket and a grind of pepper and close with the rest.
Trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

veg.n: Beach picnic egg and cress finger sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Boil and peel the eggs up to 2 days ahead; build the sandwiches up to 2 hours ahead, covered with a damp tea towel in the fridge

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Cool in iced water and peel.
Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt and pepper.
Butter the bread, spread 4 slices with the egg, snip over the cress and close with the rest.
Trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; shape the samosas up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled, or freeze raw up to 1 month; fry on the night

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, 3 for the dough, 2 for the filling

steps.text: Rub the 3 tbsp dough oil into the flour and a pinch of salt, add the water and knead to a firm smooth dough. Cover and rest.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender and drain.

Fry the cumin seeds in the 2 tbsp filling oil until they pop, add the onion and chilli and soften. Stir in the garam masala, turmeric, potato and peas, then a squeeze of lemon, the coriander and salt.
Spread out and cool the filling.
Roll the dough into 6 thin rounds and cut each in half. Fold each half into a cone, fill, wet the edge and press to seal.
Heat the frying oil in a deep pot to 170C.
Fry the samosas in batches for 5 minutes, turning, until golden and blistered. Drain.
Chop the mint, stir it through the yoghurt with salt and serve with the samosas.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the steak up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, 2 hours at least; make the salsa up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: limes, 2 for the marinade, 1 for the salsa

steps.text: Blend the orange juice, juice of 2 limes, garlic, cumin, chilli powder, oil, half the coriander and a good pinch of salt.
Pour over the steak, turn to coat and marinate in the fridge.
Char the tomatoes, onion and jalapeño in a dry heavy pan until blackened in patches.
Blitz with the rest of the coriander, the juice of the last lime and salt to a rough salsa.
Heat a grill or heavy pan until very hot. Grill the steak for 4 minutes a side.
Rest the steak, loosely covered.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and slice the avocado.
Slice the steak thinly across the grain and serve with the tortillas, avocado and salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Make the marinade and salsa up to 2 days ahead; marinate the mushrooms for 30 minutes on the night

ingredients.item: limes, 2 for the marinade, 1 for the salsa

steps.text: Blend the orange juice, juice of 2 limes, garlic, cumin, chilli powder, oil, half the coriander and a good pinch of salt.
Pour over the mushrooms, turn to coat and marinate.
Char the tomatoes, onion and jalapeño in a dry heavy pan until blackened in patches.
Blitz with the rest of the coriander, the juice of the last lime and salt to a rough salsa.
Grill the mushrooms in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side until charred and juicy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and slice the avocado.
Slice the mushrooms thickly and serve with the tortillas, avocado, feta and salsa.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and chill up to 2 days ahead, the chill takes 2 hours; whip the cream just before serving

ingredients.item: butter, 100g melted for the base, 150g for the filling
thickened cream, 150ml for the filling, 200ml to whip

steps.text: Crush the biscuits to fine crumbs, mix with the melted base butter and press firmly into a 23cm springform tin.
Chill the base. Heat the oven to 160C.
Melt the chocolate with the filling butter over low heat.
Whisk the eggs and brown sugar until thick, then whisk in the chocolate, cocoa and 150ml of the cream.
Pour onto the base and bake until set at the edges with a slight wobble.
Cool in the tin.
Chill until firm.
Whip the rest of the cream to soft peaks and serve with wedges of pie.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the sugar syrup up to 1 week ahead in the fridge; rim the glasses up to 1 hour ahead and shake to order

steps.text: Stir the sugar into the hot water until dissolved.
Cool the syrup.
Juice the limes. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with a squeezed lime half and dip in the salt.
Shake the tequila, blue curaçao, lime juice and syrup hard with half the ice.
Strain into the glasses over the rest of the ice.

af.make_ahead: Rim the glasses up to 1 hour ahead and keep the juices chilled; shake to order

steps.text: Juice the limes. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with a squeezed lime half and dip in the salt.
Shake the blue syrup, orange juice and lime juice hard with half the ice.
Strain into the glasses over the rest of the ice and top with soda water.
